anchors.anchor: Unacceptable — broken, unusable, or severely deficient
Poor — major visible or usability issues materially hurt the experience
Adequate — functional and understandable, with noticeable issues
Strong — clear and polished, with only minor issues
Excellent — highly intentional and cohesive, with no meaningful problems

questions.text: Across the full presentation, how good do the titles, captions, labels, and other content text look and read? Judge whether important content text is visibly present, typography, sizing, weight, spacing, line breaks, contrast, legibility, visual hierarchy, and whether the wording is clear, intentional, and audience-ready rather than sounding like an internal annotation. Do not judge navigation controls or presentation chrome here, and do not judge the placement or styling of non-text elements.

rating_options.label: Missing or unusable
rating_options.description: Important titles or other text are missing or unreadable, or internal-looking wording seriously undermines the presentation.

rating_options.label: Weak and confusing
rating_options.description: Major typography, hierarchy, legibility, or wording problems recur.

rating_options.label: Serviceable but flawed
rating_options.description: Text is generally readable, with noticeable missing hierarchy, awkward wording, or inconsistent typography.

rating_options.label: Clear and polished
rating_options.description: Text is clear, polished, and audience-ready, with only minor issues.

rating_options.label: Exceptional text system
rating_options.description: Typography, hierarchy, and wording are exceptionally intentional, with no meaningful issues.

questions.text: How well designed are the individual scene elements, such as boxes, arrows, icons, illustrations, and diagram nodes? Judge their shapes, proportions, fills, borders, detail, consistency, and overall craft. Do not judge their text, placement, movement, or navigation chrome here.

rating_options.label: Broken or crude
rating_options.description: Scene elements are malformed, illegible, or visibly unfinished.

rating_options.label: Weak and inconsistent
rating_options.description: Shapes, proportions, borders, fills, or visual consistency have major recurring problems.

rating_options.label: Serviceable but basic
rating_options.description: Elements communicate their purpose but feel generic, rough, or inconsistently crafted.

rating_options.label: Polished and coherent
rating_options.description: Elements are thoughtfully crafted and visually consistent, with only minor issues.

rating_options.label: Exceptional visual craft
rating_options.description: Elements are distinctive, refined, cohesive, and exceptionally well executed.

questions.text: At a normal wide viewport, how well are the text and visual elements arranged relative to one another? Judge alignment, spacing, grouping, balance, focal points, use of space, and whether anything feels crowded, disconnected, clipped, or unintentionally overlapping. Judge viewport adaptation separately under responsive visual quality.

rating_options.label: Broken composition
rating_options.description: Severe clipping, overlap, or disorganization makes the scene difficult to understand.

rating_options.label: Poorly arranged
rating_options.description: Frequent crowding, misalignment, imbalance, or disconnected elements materially harms the composition.

rating_options.label: Workable but uneven
rating_options.description: The arrangement is understandable but has noticeable crowding, dead space, weak grouping, or awkward balance.

rating_options.label: Strong composition
rating_options.description: Placement is clear, balanced, and intentional, with only minor spatial issues.

rating_options.label: Masterful composition
rating_options.description: Hierarchy, balance, grouping, and use of space are exceptional throughout.

questions.text: As you advance through the presentation, how well do the animations and scene changes work? Judge smoothness, pacing, meaningful entrances and exits, continuity of persistent elements, and whether each step visibly evolves the existing scene instead of feeling like an unrelated replacement.

rating_options.label: Broken or disorienting
rating_options.description: Motion fails, obscures content, or makes progression difficult to follow.

rating_options.label: Choppy or disconnected
rating_options.description: Transitions are frequently abrupt, poorly paced, or feel like unrelated scene replacements.

rating_options.label: Functional but uneven
rating_options.description: The scene evolves understandably, but motion is basic, inconsistent, or occasionally awkward.

rating_options.label: Smooth and meaningful
rating_options.description: Transitions clearly support the story and preserve continuity, with only minor issues.

rating_options.label: Exceptional choreography
rating_options.description: Motion is seamless, expressive, and integral to an exceptionally coherent scene evolution.

questions.text: Taken as a whole, how strong is the presentation’s visual identity? Judge its color palette, background treatment, stylistic consistency, brand character, polish, memorability, and whether it feels intentionally designed and finished. Judge the craft of individual scene elements separately.

rating_options.label: Incoherent or unfinished
rating_options.description: The overall style feels broken, conflicting, or substantially incomplete.

rating_options.label: Weak or unappealing
rating_options.description: The visual identity is inconsistent, generic, or materially under-polished.

rating_options.label: Coherent but ordinary
rating_options.description: The style works and is reasonably consistent, but lacks distinction or refinement.

rating_options.label: Distinctive and polished
rating_options.description: The presentation has a strong, cohesive visual identity with only minor imperfections.

rating_options.label: Exceptional and memorable
rating_options.description: The identity is highly distinctive, beautifully resolved, complete, and unmistakably intentional.

questions.text: How clear, discoverable, and visually integrated are the presentation controls and chrome? Judge progress indicators, previous/next controls, table of contents, mode switching, and attribution. Focus on their appearance and ease of understanding, not whether every input method technically works or how content captions are styled.

rating_options.label: Unusable or visually broken
rating_options.description: Essential controls are missing, illegible, or impossible to understand.

rating_options.label: Confusing and disconnected
rating_options.description: Controls are difficult to discover, poorly differentiated, or clash badly with the presentation.

rating_options.label: Understandable but awkward
rating_options.description: Navigation is usable and recognizable, with noticeable visual, labeling, or integration problems.

rating_options.label: Clear and integrated
rating_options.description: Controls are easy to understand and fit the presentation well, with only minor issues.

rating_options.label: Effortless and elegant
rating_options.description: Navigation is exceptionally clear, polished, discoverable, and seamlessly integrated.

questions.text: Compare the presentation at wide and narrow viewport sizes. How well does its hierarchy and composition adapt? Judge scaling, density, readability, control accessibility, clipping, overlap, and whether the narrow version still feels intentionally composed. Judge baseline wide-screen composition separately.

rating_options.label: Broken at a supported size
rating_options.description: Important content or controls become unreadable, inaccessible, clipped, or unusable.

rating_options.label: Adapts poorly
rating_options.description: Narrow or wide layouts have major crowding, scaling, overlap, or accessibility problems.

rating_options.label: Usable but compromised
rating_options.description: Both layouts function, but the narrower presentation feels noticeably cramped, reduced, or insufficiently recomposed.

rating_options.label: Strong across sizes
rating_options.description: The presentation remains clear and intentional across viewports, with only minor compromises.

rating_options.label: Exceptionally responsive
rating_options.description: Every tested size feels deliberately composed, polished, readable, and equally successful.
